description: Hand-authored synthetic medical-necessity notes for comparing keyword vs. local-LLM evidence matching. Notes deliberately use paraphrases, abbreviations, and negations. Every case is a CO-50 denial with remit date 2026-10-01, so no deadline has passed on 2026-10-24.

cases.note: Lumbar radicular pain down the left leg. Completed a 2-month course of PT plus NSAIDs without relief. Exam shows a diminished left ankle reflex and decreased sensation over the L5 dermatome.
Back pain for 3 weeks with no prior treatment tried. Patient denies numbness, tingling, or weakness in the legs. Neurologic exam is normal.

Eight weeks of supervised PT and a home stretching routine failed to improve sciatica. New left foot dorsiflexion weakness, graded 4/5. MRI ordered to evaluate candidacy for an epidural steroid injection.
Right knee gives way and gets stuck mid-flexion several times a week, with tenderness along the medial joint line. Tried ibuprofen and a 6-week PT program without improvement.
Knee pain after a twisting injury last week. No locking or catching reported. Has not yet tried physical therapy or anti-inflammatory medication. MRI pending.
Wife reports loud nightly snoring and episodes where he stops breathing during sleep. He has fallen asleep while driving. BMI 38, on lisinopril for elevated blood pressure. STOP-BANG score 6/8.
Routine visit. Patient sleeps well and denies snoring or daytime sleepiness. Normotensive, BMI 23. Sleep study requested per patient preference.

Cannot climb stairs without a rail and walks less than one block because of hip pain. Therapist advanced resistance band load from yellow to green this session. Timed up-and-go improved from 18 to 12 seconds.
Patient tolerated the session. Exercises unchanged from last visit.
Six weeks of physical therapy failed. Progressive left leg weakness and numbness.
Shoulder abduction limited to 90 degrees, which prevents overhead reaching. Home program reviewed.
Chronic low back pain; patient would like imaging. No physical therapy completed yet and plans to start PT next week. No weakness on exam.
